findings.evidence: <input id="member-input" name="membership_number" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Must be 8 digits" required=""> and, two rows later, <input id="acctnum-input" name="account_number" type="text" inputmode="numeric" required="">, both required on a form headed 'Create your account'.
findings.fix: Drop both fields from account creation, or make them optional and reserve them for a separate 'link an existing membership' flow aimed at people who already hold a number.
findings.violation: The form's own task, stated in its heading 'Create your account' and its submit button 'Create account', is to establish a new account, yet it requires a pre-existing 'Membership number (8 digits)' and a pre-existing 'Account number' to do so. A person who is joining for the first time has neither value by definition, so this required pair cannot be satisfied by anyone the sign-up is for, not merely some of them.

findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: Required fields on the account-creation form also include <input id="website-input" name="website" required type="text"> (Company website), <input id="org-input" name="organization" required> (Organization name), <input id="contacttime-input" name="contact_time" required> (Preferred contact time), <select id="shipspeed-select" required> (Preferred shipping speed), and the required day/month/year selects under legend 'Date of birth'.
findings.fix: Remove these fields from sign-up, or make them optional and move each one to the profile or checkout step where it is actually used.
findings.violation: Creating a personal account does not need a company website, an organization name, a preferred contact time, a preferred shipping speed, or a date of birth; none of these serves the stated task of opening an account, and each is a choice or a credential a later step (a profile page or the first order) could ask for instead. Recurring across five separate required fields, the cost compounds for every person who signs up.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button> sits after the 'Preferred contact time' field and before the <fieldset id="row-dob"> holding the three required date-of-birth selects, ahead of the primary submit button 'Create account' at the end of the form.
findings.fix: Move 'View details' out of the field column entirely, or place it only after every field, beside or below the primary submit, styled less prominently than it.
findings.violation: An action sits above fields: the 'View details' button interrupts the column of fields partway through the form, placed before the required date-of-birth selects rather than after every field, so a person reaching it may believe data entry is finished before three required fields remain.

findings.evidence: <input id="name-input" name="full_name" type="text" autocomplete="name" required> under label 'Full name', and later <input id="legalname-input" name="legal_name" type="text" autocomplete="name" required> under label 'Your name'.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate name field, or, if a legal name genuinely differs from a display name, relabel both fields to say so and explain why both are required.
findings.violation: The form asks for the person's name twice, once as 'Full name' and again as 'Your name', with nothing distinguishing why a second name is needed.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.
